name: wpuf_automation
description: End-to-end tests for WordPress User Frontend plugin

scripts.test: CI=false E2E_PHASE=setup npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=setup --headed && CI=false npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=e2e --headed
scripts.test:ci: E2E_PHASE=setup npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=setup && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=e2e
scripts.reset:env: npx wp-env clean all && npx wp-env start
scripts.test:parallel: rc=0; for i in 1 2 3; do SHARD_INDEX=$i CI=false npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=e2e --shard=$i/3 || rc=1; done; exit $rc
scripts.test:sharded: rc=0; npm run test:setup || rc=1; npm run test:parallel || rc=1; exit $rc
scripts.test:parallel:ci: rc=0; for i in 1 2 3; do SHARD_INDEX=$i npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=e2e --shard=$i/3 || rc=1; done; exit $rc
scripts.test:sharded:ci: rc=0; npm run test:setup:ci || rc=1; npm run test:parallel:ci || rc=1; exit $rc
scripts.test:all: rc=0; npm run test:setup || rc=1; npm run test:parallel || rc=1; npm run test:api || rc=1; exit $rc
scripts.test:all:ci: rc=0; npm run test:setup:ci || rc=1; npm run test:parallel:ci || rc=1; npm run test:api:ci || rc=1; exit $rc

author: Rubaiyat E Mohammad
